heading: INT. NEON ARENA - ESPORTS TOURNAMENT - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NEON ARENA - ESPORTS TOURNAMENT - NIGHT
Rain on the glass roof of the arena.

Thousand of fans in the dark with glowing sticks, the casters voices loud on the speakers, blue light on every face, and under the stage Wei in a fake staff jacket is carrying a cable box past two security guards who are watching the big screen and not him while Jonas sits at the final table with his headset on, his hand perfectly steady on the mouse and Bianca stands in the back corridor with a coffee she is not drinking.
Smoke machine.
Bass in the floor.
Somewhere a child crying from happiness.
Box is in. Two minutes.
units.name: WEI
paren: he wipes his palms on the jacket

units.text: You said one minute before.
units.name: JONAS
paren: headset on, eyes on the screen, he clicks twice

units.text: The guard changed. It happens.
units.name: WEI

units.text: Then we are not late. We are just on time slower.
units.name: BIANCA
paren: she puts the coffee down on a crate

units.text: Bianca your voice is too loud.
units.name: JONAS
paren: a tiny nod, he does not look at either of them

units.text: The rain gets harder.
A bright flash from the stage, the crowd screams, the casters say a name that is not Jonas.
They are looking at you. The man in the grey suit. Left side.
units.name: BIANCA
paren: she moves closer to the door

units.text: Which man.
units.name: WEI
paren: he puts the box down very slowly

units.text: The one who is not clapping.
units.name: BIANCA
paren: she does not point, she only lifts her chin

units.text: Wind pushes at the roof.
Cold air comes under the door.
Far away a guard laughs at something on his phone.
Done. Money is moving. Nobody stand up.
units.name: JONAS
paren: he types something fast, then removes his hands from the keyboard and puts them on his knees

units.text: Then why is your leg shaking.
units.name: WEI
paren: he smiles with only half of his mouth

units.text: Because I am going to win this game also.
units.name: JONAS
paren: he presses the knee flat with his palm

units.text: The grey suit is gone.
units.name: BIANCA
paren: she opens the door a little, one finger on the handle

units.text: Nobody speaks.
On the screen the countdown goes to ten.
